intro: Choosing between full body vs portrait anime art comes down to what you want the drawing to communicate. A portrait focuses attention on the face, expression, hair, and upper-body styling, while a full body commission shows the character’s complete design, pose, outfit, and silhouette. Both can make memorable gifts, profile images, wall art, or original-character references. At Anime Cabinet, human artists hand-draw each commission in one of 24 anime and cartoon-inspired styles. The result is an original interpretation of you, your loved one, or your character—not an AI filter and not an impersonation of a copyrighted character. You can request a style inspired by worlds such as [Jujutsu Kaisen](/portraits/jujutsu-kaisen), [Demon Slayer](/portraits/demon-slayer), or [One Piece](/portraits/one-piece), while becoming an original character in that visual language. A preview arrives within 72 hours, and unlimited free revisions are included.
